selection_basis: Selected after the Jackpot rank-three failure because the published abstract identifies a nearby galaxy-scale strong lens with spatially resolved stellar kinematics and a self-consistent HST-lensing plus dynamics analysis. Selection used no gravity residual, reported gamma value, dark-matter parameter, or alternative-gravity score.

published_observable_claims: HST imaging resolves lensed arcs around the foreground galaxy
MUSE supplies spatially resolved stellar kinematics
the paper models the observed arc light and kinematics jointly

published_dynamics_support.accepted_support_basis: The primary source explicitly models only the central 4 arcseconds; this validity support, not the full cube footprint, defines overlap.

published_lens_geometry.interpretation: The extended arcs establish sensitivity beyond one enclosed-mass number, but do not establish three nuisance-marginalized response modes.

hst.purpose: lens light and PSF-aware baryonic light model
extended arc surface brightness after lens-light subtraction

required_facts: exact MUSE proposal and public product identifiers
exact HST proposal, filters, exposure products, PSF, and noise inputs
published accepted dynamics support and number of numerical bins
observable arc masks or image positions and source redshift likelihood
whether the public likelihood can be rerun without importing the paper's GR-fitted posterior
baryonic light model and mass-to-light nuisance inputs
kinematic, lensing, and shared systematic covariance availability
source_and_metadata_audit.success: Public raw products are source-traceable, the extended arcs lie inside accepted dynamics support, and a frozen observable-level Jacobian can test at least three lens-response basis directions after source-light and lens-nuisance marginalization.
source_and_metadata_audit.failure: Retain E325 only as a one-effective-radius control if the marginalized image-level Jacobian rank is below three; never promote it from pixel count alone.

progress_checkpoint.advance_if: The source and archive audit supports freezing an exact acquisition and image-level Jacobian protocol without inspecting science arrays.
progress_checkpoint.rethink_if: The frozen nuisance-marginalized Jacobian supplies fewer than three singular directions above its predeclared numerical and perturbation-stability thresholds. Retain the object as a one-radius control rather than treating high pixel count as independent radial rank.
